title: BIRD-History: A Benchmark for History-Driven Text-to-SQL with Fine-Grained Knowledge Annotations
abstract: arXiv:2608.29345v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: While recent Large Language Model (LLM)-based text-to-SQL systems achieve impressive performance on standard benchmarks, they struggle when user queries implicitly rely on domain-specific knowledge, such as business logic, data conventions, and analytical practices, that is neither captured by the schema nor explicitly stated in the natural language question. Historical SQL query logs offer a valuable source of such knowledge, yet existing benchmarks do not adequately support evaluation of history-driven approaches. To address this gap, we introduce BIRD-History, a benchmark consisting of 1,393 tasks across 11 databases, designed to evaluate text-to-SQL systems' ability to ground underspecified natural language questions using historical SQL scripts. translated_title: BIRD-History：一个带有细粒度知识标注的历史驱动文本到SQL（Text-to-SQL）基准测试
translated_abstract: 尽管近期基于大语言模型（LLM）的文本到SQL系统在标准基准测试中取得了令人瞩目的性能，但当用户查询隐含地依赖于特定领域知识（例如业务逻辑、数据规范和分析惯例）时，这些系统便难以应对，因为此类知识既未被数据库模式所捕获，也未在自然语言问题中被明确表述。历史SQL查询日志为此类知识提供了宝贵的来源，然而现有基准测试未能充分支持对历史驱动方法的评估。为填补这一空白，我们提出了BIRD-History，这是一个由11个数据库上的1,393个任务组成的基准测试，旨在评估文本到SQL系统利用历史SQL脚本为欠规范的自然语言问题提供依据（grounding）的能力。每个任务都标注了真值标签，指明哪些历史查询包含相关知识以及哪些SQL子句编码了这些知识，从而能够对知识检索与知识定位进行系统化的评估。
tldr: 该论文提出了BIRD-History基准测试，通过11个数据库上1,393个带细粒度知识标注（标明相关历史查询及其SQL子句）的任务，评估文本到SQL系统利用历史SQL查询日志中的领域知识来理解欠规范自然语言问题的能力。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces BIRD-History, a benchmark of 1,393 tasks across 11 databases with fine-grained annotations identifying relevant historical queries and their SQL clauses, designed to evaluate text-to-SQL systems' ability to ground underspecified natural language questions using historical SQL scripts.
